scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

conditions.raw_text: Families identified as deprived or vulnerable under SECC 2011 criteria or senior citizen aged 70+.

documents.raw_text: Ration Card or Family Composite ID

benefits.raw_text: Cashless health cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

exclusions.raw_text: Beneficiary families already covered under CGHS, ECHS, or CAPF health schemes.
